newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel gains on dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel gains on dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel's representative rate was fixed slightly higher against the dollar and the basket of key foreign currencies on Monday in quiet trading, dealers said.
"Trading was mixed and balanced and the market was very quiet today. There was no clear trend and the shekel closed almost unchanged," said Guy Levi at Bank Leumi.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.3920 shekels against 3.3940 on Friday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6927 shekels against 3.6972 on Friday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9161 shekels per 100 yen compared with 2.9256 on Friday, and against the mark at 1.9922 shekels compared with 1.9954 on Friday.
In the late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.3910 shekels.
